prompt:
Locked-off camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; one continuous shot. The big gloved hand in the foreground stays up, fingers spread, never passing over her face: on each beat it wiggles its fingers like a stage magician, then snaps them, then waves slowly side to side. Behind, the small woman in the canary-yellow coat stands on the stage, head tilted showily, facing the lens, her other hand on her hip. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. Her mask stays exactly as in the first frame: white ring, one red triangle, no holes. Smoke drifts in the spotlight. A finger snap, cloth rustle.

Thanks.
